messages:
maria: Heads up — after the mapping tweak deployed ~03:10 UTC, we're seeing some JIT SSO users created with no explicit roles. In a few tenants the audit shows a fallback to the default role 'org_admin' instead of 'org_member'.
noah: yikes. any repro steps / example assertion?
maria: repro attached below (redacted). example SAML attrs we got for one login: 
```
NameID: user@cust.example.com
displayName: <MISSING>
email: user@cust.example.com
groups: [engineering]
role: <absent>
```
mapping expression we pushed: `groups.contains("admin") ? "org_admin" : (displayName ? "org_member" : null)`
jake: looks like the expression returns null if displayName is missing, and null triggers our provisioning fallback which was misconfigured to grant org_admin in some tenants. nasty edge-case.
security-bot: audit query: `SELECT event_time, user, target_role FROM audit.logs WHERE event_type='role_assignment' AND tenant='cust.example.com' AND event_time > '2026-03-03T03:00:00Z'` -> shows 6 unexpected org_admin assignments between 03:12-03:16 UTC. ids: a1b2.. a1b7..
maria: confirmed. rolling back mapping change in staging now, will rollback prod mapping if we see more.
noah: can we also check if anything else could nullify displayName? upstream IdP change, SCIM filter, or a recent Okta transform?
maria: okta side hasn't changed according to last config diff (checked at 03:20). however there was a KMS key rotation for `saml-signer` on Mar 3 at 02:58 — I don't think that affects attributes, but flagging in case.
sre-bot: incident created: INC-2026-0313-19, priority: P2, owners: @maria @noah.
jake: short-term mitigation: update mapping to explicitly default to org_member: `groups.contains("admin") ? "org_admin" : "org_member"` — and add a defender that refuses to auto-grant org_admin unless tenant flag `allow_auto_admin` is true.
security-bot: add-on: scan audit logs for role assignments where input assertion lacked displayName. Query: `WHERE payload->'saml'->>'displayName' IS NULL`
maria: running that now across last 24h. so far only 8 users affected across 3 tenants. none have had admin actions logged yet.
noah: postmortem checklist: 1) revert mapping (if prod), 2) add unit/integration tests for missing attrs, 3) add guard for auto-admin, 4) create alert for sudden spike in role_assignment events, 5) update docs about required SAML attributes.
jake: +1. I'll open a PR for the mapping test and defender change.
maria: thanks — I'll finish rollback and notify affected customers. follow-up meeting in #eng-security-calendar at 11:00 PT. :thumbsup:
